summary.vi: Tường thuật phát biểu bằng động từ tường thuật + mệnh đề nội dung, có lùi thì khi góc nhìn tường thuật ở quá khứ.
summary.en: Report what someone said with a reporting verb plus a content clause, shifting the tense back when the reporting viewpoint is in the past.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn kể lại lời ai đó đã nói, thay vì trích dẫn nguyên văn.
when_to_use.en: When you retell what someone said instead of quoting their exact words.

when_to_use.vi: Khi động từ tường thuật ở quá khứ (said, told) và bạn muốn thể hiện góc nhìn quá khứ.
when_to_use.en: When the reporting verb is in the past (said, told) and you want to show a past viewpoint.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn cần đổi đại từ và cụm thời gian cho phù hợp với thời điểm tường thuật.
when_to_use.en: When you need to change pronouns and time phrases to fit the moment of reporting.

when_to_use.vi: Khi bạn muốn dùng tell thay vì say vì có người nghe được nhắc đến.
when_to_use.en: When you want to use tell instead of say because the listener is mentioned.

examples.text: He said that he was busy.

annotation.vi: Lùi thì: hiện tại → quá khứ khi tường thuật ở quá khứ.
annotation.en: Backshift: present → past when reporting in the past.

translation.en: He said that he was busy.

examples.text: She told me that she had finished.

annotation.vi: Lùi thì: quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành.

translation.vi: Cô ấy nói với tôi rằng cô ấy đã xong.
translation.en: She told me that she had finished.

examples.text: They said they would call later.

annotation.vi: Lùi thì: will → would khi tường thuật ở quá khứ.
annotation.en: Backshift: will → would when reporting in the past.

translation.vi: Họ nói họ sẽ gọi sau.
translation.en: They said they would call later.

common_mistakes.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_mistakes.right: She told me that she was tired.

reason.vi: say không nhận tân ngữ chỉ người nghe trực tiếp; tell mới nhận.
reason.en: say does not take a direct listener object; tell does.

explain.vi: said không cần tân ngữ chỉ người nghe; told cần tân ngữ.
explain.en: said does not need a listener object; told does.

quick_practice.q: She told me that she ___ finished.

explain.vi: Lùi thì: quá khứ → quá khứ hoàn thành khi tường thuật ở quá khứ.
explain.en: Backshift: past → past perfect when reporting in the past.

explain.vi: Lùi thì: will → would khi tường thuật ở quá khứ.
explain.en: Backshift: will → would when reporting in the past.

prompt.vi: Viết một câu tường thuật điều ai đó đã nói với bạn.
prompt.en: Write a sentence reporting what someone said to you.

sample.text: My friend said that she was tired.

corrections.issue: R5 example 'Mia says she is ready.' uses present reporting verb, which does not illustrate the backshift rule taught in this point.
corrections.fix: Replaced with 'They said they would call later.' to show will → would backshift.

corrections.issue: R5 mistake 'He said he will come the next day.' is listed as a mistake but the correct version 'He said he would come the next day.' is not given as a separate example.
corrections.fix: Added 'They said they would call later.' as an example and kept the mistake pair in common_mistakes.
